description: This file defines the MaintenanceVisit class, a document type in ERPNext for managing maintenance visits, including validation, status updates, and related warranty claim updates.

classes.name: MaintenanceVisit
classes.description: A class representing a maintenance visit, inheriting from TransactionBase, with methods for validation, status updates, and related warranty claim processing.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for activity feed, indicating the customer name.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates that serial numbers in purposes exist in the Serial No database.

methods.name: validate_maintenance_date
methods.description: Ensures the maintenance date falls within the scheduled start and end dates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs serial number and maintenance date validation.

methods.name: update_completion_status
methods.description: Updates the completion status of the maintenance schedule detail.

methods.name: update_actual_date
methods.description: Updates the actual maintenance date in the schedule detail.

methods.name: update_customer_issue
methods.description: Updates related warranty claim with resolution details based on maintenance visit status.

methods.name: check_if_last_visit
methods.description: Checks if this is the last maintenance visit for the associated document (e.g., warranty claim).

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submission, including updating customer issues and status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions upon cancellation, including validation of last visit.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Placeholder for update actions (currently does nothing).
